provenance: Exact text now validated against the confirmed original proposal and August interim; see alignment/SOURCE_REVIEW.json
main: How can an AI-powered, policy-aware Education and Career Pathway Intelligence System support Sri Lankan learners through personalised, explainable, and accessible pathway recommendations?

supporting.I: How can learner profiles, eligibility requirements and pathway knowledge be integrated to generate suitable recommendations?
supporting.II: How can explainable recommendation mechanisms improve user understanding and trust?
supporting.III: How can alternative pathway generation and skill-gap identification support educational and career planning?
supporting.IV: How can multilingual support, mobile usability and voice-assisted input improve accessibility?
supporting.V: How effective is the prototype in providing relevant and usable pathway guidance?
